title: Investor data is exposed
summary: Contain it, assess what was exposed and make the notices the law requires on time, with counsel.

situation.trigger: Investor records, such as tax ids or bank details, may have been accessed by someone who should not have them.

outlineSteps: Contain the exposure and stop further access
Preserve logs, emails and system records
Bring in counsel and, where needed, a forensic firm
Work out what data was exposed and whose it was
Notify the insurance carrier if the policy covers it
List with counsel each notice required and its deadline
Reset access and fix the cause
Answer investor questions with one consistent message
Record what happened and what changed
